items.title: Governance of superintelligence
items.summary: Now is a good time to start thinking about the governance of superintelligence—future AI systems dramatically more capable than even AGI.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布关于超级智能治理的宏观思考文章，呼吁行业开始重视并规划远超现有AGI水平的未来AI系统的治理框架。

aiReview.reasonZh: 文章主要探讨超智能AI的长期治理哲学，缺乏具体的模型或技术实现细节。
